integrity: All-plane equivalence is proved by the affine incidence axioms; executable finite enumerations corroborate this and prove a finite logical rank boundary. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the pure binary inclusion relation is used; the result need not survive added predicates or counting quantifiers.
Applies to flat posets of finite affine planes, not general geometric lattices or higher-dimensional affine spaces.
Historical novelty has not been independently certified; an unidentified broader normal-form theorem is a residual risk.
title: Two unrestricted three-variable theories of finite affine-plane flat posets
